name: verify_claim
description: Decide one claim against evidence bytes the caller supplies, with probity-verify.

name: verify_sample
description: Run a bundled sample claim: contradicted, not_established or supported.

name: list_vector_corpora
description: Name every shipped corpus with its suite revision and vector counts where it declares them.

name: run_vectors
description: Replay one corpus with the bundled reference verifier; per-vector rows come back in pages.

name: explain_vector
description: Return one vector: its manifest entry, the conditions it tests, and its input bytes.

name: lookup_term
description: Look a term up in the released vocabulary by exact key; otherwise suggest close keys.

name: check_artifact_digest
description: Check that an artifact has a digest a TEA, CycloneDX or in-toto document names.
